name: Fulvestrant
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: Selective estrogen-receptor degrader (SERD); endocrine therapy: requires HR-positive (ER and/or PR positive), HER2-negative disease. May be used as single-agent endocrine therapy or as the endocrine backbone with a CDK4/6 inhibitor or a targeted agent. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-Q, and DeVita 12th ed. (FALCON).

lineOfTherapy: first-line or later endocrine therapy for HR-positive/HER2-negative recurrent or metastatic breast cancer; frequently combined with a CDK4/6 inhibitor or a targeted agent

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: HR-positive (ER and/or PR positive) and HER2-negative

drugs.name: Fulvestrant (loading, cycle 1)

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 14 of 15 (Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on Days 1 and 15, first cycle)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on days 1 and 15 of the first 28-day cycle (loading). Dose corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. FALCON (fulvestrant 500 mg, line 30818).

drugs.name: Fulvestrant (maintenance)

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 14 of 15 (Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on Day 1 of subsequent 28-day cycles)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle (maintenance).

supportiveCare: For premenopausal patients, give concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH analog) per BINV-N.
Administer as two 250 mg IM injections (one per buttock) per labeling.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 30818 (Fulvestrant 500 mg versus anastrozole 1 mg for hormone-receptor-positive advanced breast cancer, FALCON); line 188069

guideline.locator: Dosing: Targeted Therapies for Recurrent/Stage IV Disease, Fulvestrant 500 mg IM on Days 1 and 15 then Day 1 of subsequent cycles, BINV-Q 14 of 15; HR-Positive/HER2-Negative setting BINV-Q 5 of 15

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent fulvestrant. Serves subtype #5 (HR-positive/HER2-negative), histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. Dose grounded in both layers: DeVita 12th ed. FALCON (fulvestrant 500 mg, line 30818) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15 (500 mg IM on days 1 and 15 of the first cycle, then 500 mg IM on day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle). Continue until progression (cycles null). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
